**Finding re-submitted: compliant** — no redline, no counterparty comment.

The repair addressed the failed deterministic check on warranty duration by citing § 19.2 directly as the quote and stating the period explicitly in the rationale:

- **Duration:** "ninety days" (90 days / three months) for Deliverable conformity, measured from the **later** of delivery or acceptance, plus continuous conformity for hosted Services **throughout the subscription term** — which exceeds the preferred 12-month software standard. The regex miss was purely a phrasing artifact (the number is spelled out, not numeric), so no edit is warranted.
- **Standard (19.1):** professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel per industry standards, plus material conformity to documentation and specifications.
- **Remedy (19.4):** re-perform / repair / replace at no charge, then termination and refund of Fees paid — matching the model remedy — and expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **Other warranties (19.3):** no malicious code; compliance with Applicable Law.
- **Disclaimer (19.5):** implied warranties only; no "AS IS," and express warranties, service levels, indemnities and remedies are expressly preserved.
